The sidecar is outside the locale and was not edited. findings.summary: Width-budget flag, not a meaning defect. Four es keys exceed the en sidecar's soft word budget by one word at every count because Spanish needs a 'de' complement: fold.receipt.job_result '# resultado de trabajo', fold.receipt.wake '# recibo de despertar' and fold.receipt.monitor_prompt '# prompt de monitor' are 4 words against 'Two to three words including the count'; fold.sentence.web_lead/web_follow 'Buscó en la web # veces' is 6 words against 'Three to five'. The 'many' arm's extra 'de' is not a width issue (it only renders at multiples of 10^6). No shorter faithful phrasing exists for the receipt units (glossary: wake -> despertar, monitor kept, job -> trabajo). For the sentence keys a one-word-shorter and equally idiomatic option is 'Hizo # búsquedas web' (4 words; one: 'Hizo # búsqueda web'; follow: 'hizo # ...'). Recommend a rendered narrow-width check of the receipt group header; no change required.
findings.before: {count, plural, one {# resultado de trabajo} ...} / Buscó en la web # veces
findings.after: unchanged (receipt units); optional 'Hizo # búsquedas web' for sentence.web_lead/web_follow
